source_passages.quotation: **Turmoil, in order:** Lose one VP per bird Decree card **including both Loyal Viziers**; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. answer.ruling: Lose one VP for each bird Decree card, counting both Loyal Viziers; discard every Decree card except the Viziers; flip the current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none is face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck the Viziers in the new leader's columns. Turmoil does not remove the Eyrie's warriors or buildings from the map.
Turmoil ends Daylight and proceeds to the normal Evening: score the VP on the rightmost empty roost-track space, draw one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, then discard down to five.
